obligations.source_text: The complete horizontal geomungo, its fixed fret row, six thick strings, seated support, and both hand mechanics must be clearly readable at true instrument scale.

bindings.zither_form_phrase: a long horizontal wooden zither with a small set of strings, specifically six thick strings
bindings.fret_bridge_phrase: prominent fixed gwae frets coexist with movable bridges on the playing surface
bindings.suldae_phrase: the right hand uses a short suldae stick on the strings, with its tip in visible contact
bindings.support_phrase: the fretted zither rests horizontally before the seated performer at a plausible full instrument scale
bindings.gayageum_confound_phrase: bare-finger plucking across many individual bridges does not substitute for the visible fixed-fret and suldae system
